title: Dynamo v1.5.0-kimi-k3-post.1
text:
Release Notes
Dynamo v1.5.0-kimi-k3-post.1 is an experimental snapshot build with Kimi-K3 support on the Dynamo SGLang backend. It is not recommended for production and is not a QA-gated release. APIs, behavior, and defaults may change before stable support. Use it for evaluation, testing, and early feedback only.
Summary
Dynamo v1.5.0-kimi-k3-post.1 serves moonshotai/Kimi-K3 from an SGLang runtime built on Dynamo 1.5.1 and SGLang v0.5.18. The image includes the two Kimi-K3 fixes that base still needs: DCP prefill/decode with DSpark draft-KV transfer, and the SM100 MoonViT cuDNN guard for image encode (#15657).
GB300 SGLang recipes run that image. Aggregated serving uses two workers (16x GB300, DCP8 attention, TP8 MoE) with load-aware routing and DSpark. Disaggregated serving is 1P1D (16x GB300; prefill TEP8, decode DCP8 attention and TEP8 MoE) with Mooncake KV transfer over NVLink. Workers set SGLANG_FORCE_COARSE_WAR_BARRIER=1. The recipe includes a shared model cache and an AIPerf replay of the 64K-ISL / 400-OSL / 90% KV-reuse agentic trace (#15658, #15919).

About Kimi-K3
Kimi-K3 is Moonshot AI's hybrid-attention mixture-of-experts model with multimodal (text + image) support and up to 1M-token context. This preview serves it through Dynamo's SGLang backend with aggregated and 1P1D disaggregated agentic recipes on GB300, using DSpark speculative decoding.
Full Changelog
SGLang Backend
Kimi-K3 runtime on SGLang v0.5.18: The published runtime is Dynamo 1.5.1 SGLang with two baked-in fixes: DCP prefill/decode plus DSpark draft-KV transfer, and a MoonViT cuDNN guard so SM100 image encode does not crash. The image build checks the patched files against the benchmarked hashes (#15657).
Recipes
GB300 SGLang recipes on the post.1 image: Aggregated serving is two TP8/DCP8 workers (16x GB300) with load-aware routing, prefix caching, and DSpark. Disaggregated serving is 1P1D (16x GB300) with Mooncake KV transfer over MNNVL and the same DSpark draft. Workers set SGLANG_FORCE_COARSE_WAR_BARRIER=1. Context length is 1,048,576. The perf job replays the agentic Mooncake trace; the published GB300 figures use synthetic acceptance length 4.05 (aggregated: 91.3 output tok/s/GPU, 55.6 user tok/s P50, TTFT P50 486 ms at concurrency 36; 1P1D: 62.0 output tok/s/GPU, 77.6 user tok/s P50, TTFT P50 4,793 ms at concurrency 18) (recipe folder, docs) (#15658, #15919).
Getting Started
Deployment is Kubernetes-based (Dynamo Platform + DynamoGraphDeployment). Use the GB300 SGLang manifests under recipes/kimi-k3/sglang: create the namespace, Hugging Face token secret hf-token-secret, and nvcr.io pull secret, populate the shared model cache, apply the aggregated or disaggregated manifest, and smoke-test /v1/chat/completions with model moonshotai/Kimi-K3. Benchmark steps are in the perf README.
Known Issues / Limitations
This is a branch-specific snapshot build, not a QA-gated stable release.
This snapshot publishes an SGLang image only. vLLM manifests on the branch still reference nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/vllm-runtime:1.4.0-kimi-k3-dev.1.
SGLang manifests on this branch are GB300-only (aggregated 16x and disaggregated 1P1D 16x). There is no H200 SGLang profile.
The GB300 tok/s figures above use synthetic speculative acceptance (acc_len 4.05). They are not real DSpark verification results. The serving manifests default to real DSpark; synthetic acceptance is a benchmark-only setting.
During a long prefill, the canary health check (DYN_HEALTH_CHECK_REQUEST_TIMEOUT, 3 seconds) can fail and Kubernetes can restart a busy worker. If the worker log shows Health check timeout for on generate, set DYN_HEALTH_CHECK_ENABLED=false on each SGLang worker.
Requests containing logprobs or stop_token_ids are not supported and may cause disaggregated recipes to crash or enter a bad state.
With JSON structured decoding, output for non-object top-level items can appear in reasoning_content instead of content.
